newsitem.title: JAPAN: Honen to buy some Nikka Fats shares from Nichimen.
newsitem.headline: Honen to buy some Nikka Fats shares from Nichimen.

text.p: Honen Corp said on Friday that it will buy shares in Nikka Fats & Oils. from Nichimen Corp, making it the largest shareholder in Nikka Fats.
Honen, which already holds a 19.8 percent stake in Nikka Fats, will buy 1.74 million Nikka Fats shares from Nichimen on March 25, 1997, Honen said in a statement.
Afterwards, Honen will become the largest shareholder in Nikka Fats, holding 2.89 million shares in the firm or a 49.83 percent stake.
Nichimen, which is currently the largest shareholder in Nikka Fats, will cut its stake to 19.96 percent.
